newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux shares up, Volvo flat.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux shares up, Volvo flat.

text.p: Shares in Swedish appliance maker Electrolux jumped at the open on Monday after the company announced its chief executive and president Leif Johansson was quitting to take over from Soren Gyll at AB Volvo.
Electrolux shares jumped nine crown to 435 crowns. Volvo shares were flat, slipping 0.5 crowns to 176.5 crowns.
"It could be positive for Electrolux as some people do not think Johansson really ever got to grips with the company's problems," said one analyst who did not want to be named.
"We could see the share price benefit, bouncing off last week's weak results."
Analysts said as Gyll would remain on the board at Volvo, investors would assume the strategy would remain the same and the share price would not be greatly affected.
Atlas Copco's CEO Michael Treschow is to replace Johansson at Electrolux. Atlas Copco shares slipped 0.5 to 169.5 crowns in early trade.
